customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be of good quality, with positive feedback about its taste, ease of use, and water quality. However, the reliability receives mixed reviews, with some reporting it stops working while others say it performs well. Moreover, durability is a concern as filters break within 6 months, and there are issues with continuous leakage from the machine. Additionally, water wastage is a significant problem, with customers noting that 20 liters are wasted to produce 8 liters of purified water.

reviews.author: Divya Shibu
reviews.title: Good product
reviews.body: If you get those product below 13k it is good. The water taste is very good. The storage capacity is good for a small family. It produces lot of waste water. The filter replacement costs is huge. It is a good looking unit.

reviews.author: Chandra Mohan Mamgai
reviews.title: Packaging
reviews.body: The item itself was satisfactory, yet the packaging was disappointing. The carton showed tears in several spots, raising concerns about potential drops or mishandling. Its exterior appeared pressed against something during shipping, with numerous wrinkles visible. I hope future packaging avoids such issues.

reviews.author: Mohan B.
reviews.title: Product Good Installation worrisome and worst
reviews.body: Kent as product is good. Used from Oct 2006 Oct till 2018. Service in Big Cities looted the customers because Kent uses 3rd Party Vendors for Service. They loot you if you have no basic knowledge of filter systems. I faced the same issue If you don't buy Kent Pre Filter they don't connect the pre filter. They connect a thick pipe so that we get into trouble connecting it. Very Shady 3rd Party VENDORS Very bad experience from 3rd party vendors.
